searchText: Hi all, the latest hive update to the Cancun Engine API tests for devnet-9 has been merged to master: https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/840 and https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/839 It contains the updated beacon root contract (`0xbEac00dDB15f3B6d645C48263dC93862413A222D`), as well as updated tests from the Engine API suite running on Cancun and using Blob transactions everywhere, so there is an increase in the number of tests in the `engine-cancun` suite from 55 to 216 tests. We will be updating hivecancun page in the coming days, along with the new EVM tests from execution-spec-tests, in the meantime please use the following command on hive master branch to run the entire suite locally: ``` ./hive --client-file ./configs/cancun.yaml --client <client name> --sim ethereum/engine --sim.limit "engine-cancun/" --docker.nocache <client name> ``` If there are any issues please let me or <@755913785620824175> know and we can help out with triaging of any issue, or also if you need to update the docker image in https://github.com/ethereum/hive/blob/master/configs/cancun.yaml cc <@543900561460822016> <@758579010027782144> <@508125616940515329> <@827653956955406406> <@583892532644151312> Although, there isn't a strict order of the checks enforced by the spec, the spec states "This validation MUST be instantly run in all cases even during active sync process." which makes the client to respond instantly if versionedHashes does not match the expected ones Can we make a release of execution-spec-tests with the new beacon root contract address? So https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7672 isn't included? For both `execution-spec-tests` and the `engine-cancun` hive sim we need to wait for the updated bytecode - so in the meantime it be great to use the current contract in the spec, the hive sim should have a lot more coverage But <@412614104222531604> is saying we should aim to have https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7672 in devnet9. I was suggesting that we wait till that PR gets approved, as we didn't neccessary plan to have devnet 10 anymore. Happy to hear what client teams and testing teams would like to do tho From our end can we can have a new release of `execution-spec-tests` by the end of the day (without the additional 4788 changes) - which includes additional tests, and then create another release with #7672 included once its ready Or we can simply wait until #7672 is approved and then simply do 1 release for the tests - is there any preference? Somewhat related - if dn9 is the last devnet would we want wait to include the BLOBBASEFEE opcode EIP as well (https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7516) ? (Or is this not being considered for Dencun) We tried this draft yesterday and the problem was that the bytecode was incorrect (the `HISTORY_BUFFER_LENGTH` is different from the EIP description to what is used in the bytecode), so we rolled back on using it until it gets merged

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content:
Hi all, the latest hive update to the Cancun Engine API tests for devnet-9 has been merged to master: https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/840 and https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/839
It contains the updated beacon root contract (`0xbEac00dDB15f3B6d645C48263dC93862413A222D`), as well as updated tests from the Engine API suite running on Cancun and using Blob transactions everywhere, so there is an increase in the number of tests in the `engine-cancun` suite from 55 to 216 tests.
We will be updating hivecancun page in the coming days, along with the new EVM tests from execution-spec-tests, in the meantime please use the following command on hive master branch to run the entire suite locally:
```
./hive --client-file ./configs/cancun.yaml --client <client name> --sim ethereum/engine --sim.limit "engine-cancun/" --docker.nocache <client name>
```
If there are any issues please let me or <@755913785620824175> know and we can help out with triaging of any issue, or also if you need to update the docker image in https://github.com/ethereum/hive/blob/master/configs/cancun.yaml

cc <@543900561460822016> <@758579010027782144> <@508125616940515329> <@827653956955406406> <@583892532644151312>

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: Although, there isn't a strict order of the checks enforced by the spec, the spec states "This validation MUST be instantly run in all cases even during active sync process." which makes the client to respond instantly if versionedHashes does not match the expected ones
